BRANDING.ORGANIZATION_LOGO_DESC: Logo will be used for printing badges,passes and sending emails.
BRANDING.MOBILE_LOGO_DESC: Logo uploaded here will be used in the VIZTRO mobile application replacing web logo.
BRANDING.TABLET_LOGO_DESC: Logo uploaded here will be used in the VIZTRO tablet application replacing web logo.

ENABLE_HOSTS_SELECTION.ON: If turned "ON" then visitor will be able to see a list of hosts to select who they are here to see.
ENABLE_HOSTS_SELECTION.OFF: If turned "OFF" no hosts list appears to the visitors while creating check-in request.

HOST_REQUIRED_FOR_VISITOR_TYPE.ENABLE: Enable Visitor type from below list for which visitor select host to check-in into the organization location.

VISITOR_CHECKIN_APPROVAL.ON: If turned "ON" then Host will be approving the request for the vistor to check-in.
VISITOR_CHECKIN_APPROVAL.OFF: If turned "OFF" no hosts approval is required to check-in into the organization location.

VISITOR_CHECKIN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.ENABLE: Enable Visitor type from below list for which visitor check-in approval will be required for the organization location.

ORGANIZATION_BANNER.DESCRIPTION: Print a organization banner with QR Code. Visitor can check-in by using this QR code using the VIZTRO mobile or tablet app.

PUSH.HEADING: Push Notification
PUSH.ON: If turned "ON"then push notification for devices will be enabled for your organization.
PUSH.OFF: If turned "OFF" then push notification for devices will be disabled for your organization.

EMAIL_ON_VISITOR_CHECKIN.ON: If turned "ON" Email notification will be sent to visitor's EmailId with their checkin details.
EMAIL_ON_VISITOR_CHECKIN.OFF: If turned "OFF" no Email notification will be sent to visitor with their checkin. details.

EMAIL_ON_VISITOR_CHECKOUT.ON: If turned "ON" Email notification will be sent to visitor's EmailId with their checkout details.
EMAIL_ON_VISITOR_CHECKOUT.OFF: If turned "OFF" no Email notification will be sent to visitor with their checkout.

EMAIL_NOTIFICATION_FOR_HOST.ON: If turned "ON" then host will be notified about visitor activity. Host must have email enabled in their preference.
EMAIL_NOTIFICATION_FOR_HOST.OFF: If turned "OFF" host will not be notify on any visitors activity.

SEND_INVITE_REMIND_EMAIL.ON: If turned "ON" then remind visitors with an email 20 minutes before their invitation begins.
SEND_INVITE_REMIND_EMAIL.OFF: If turned "OFF" no reminder will be send to visitors.

VISITOR_CHECKOUT_NOTIFICATION_HOST.ON: If turned "ON" then host will be notified when visitor check-out. Host must have email enabled in their preference.
VISITOR_CHECKOUT_NOTIFICATION_HOST.OFF: If turned "OFF" no host will be notify on check-out of their respective visitors.

NOTIFICATION_FOR_HOST.ON: If turned "ON" then notify Hosts of visitors via SMS. Hosts must have a mobile number lilsted and must have SMS enabled in their preference.
NOTIFICATION_FOR_HOST.OFF: If turned "OFF" no SMS notification will be sent to Hosts of their respective visitors.

VISITOR_NOTIFICATION_HOST_RESPONSE.ON: If turned "ON" then notify visitor via SMS of their check-in request whether accepted or rejected. This requires Check-in approvals to be on.
VISITOR_NOTIFICATION_HOST_RESPONSE.OFF: If turned "OFF" no SMS notification will be sent to Hosts of their respective visitors.

CAPTURE_ID.ON: If turned "ON" then visitor Id will be required at the time of check-in through mobile or tablet.
CAPTURE_ID.OFF: If turned "OFF" visitor Id will not be captured at the time of check-in.

CAPTURE_VISITOR_PHOTO.ON: If turned "ON" then visitor will be ask to capture own photo when doing check-in through mobile or tablet.
CAPTURE_VISITOR_PHOTO.OFF: If turned "OFF" visitor photo will not be captured at the time of check-in.

INVITATION_REQUIRED.HEADING: Invitation Required
INVITATION_REQUIRED.VALUE: Visitor can only do checkin by using required invitation sent by notification. Enable the visitor type you want to apply this setting.

RESTRICT_INVITATION_REQUIRED_TIME.ON: If turned "ON" "Invitation Required" Visitor type will not be able to check-in into the organization until their invite start. Enable the visitor type you want to apply this setting.
RESTRICT_INVITATION_REQUIRED_TIME.OFF: If turned "OFF" "Invitation Required" Visitor type can do check-in even before the invite start.

REMEMBER_VISITOR.ON: If turned "ON" then allow returning visitor to facilitate the check-in process using their email or mobile number.
REMEMBER_VISITOR.OFF: If turned "OFF" no visitor will be facilitated for check-in.

EMAIL_REQUIRED.ON: If turned "ON" then visitor email address is required during check-in.
EMAIL_REQUIRED.OFF: If turned "OFF" visitor email address will be optional. request.

CONFIRM_EMAIL_REQUIRED.VALUE: Confirm Email Required ( Mobile app only)
CONFIRM_EMAIL_REQUIRED.ON: If turned "ON" then visitor email address to be verified.
CONFIRM_EMAIL_REQUIRED.OFF: If turned "OFF" email address field will not be visible to visitor. request.

MOBILE_NO_REQUIRED.ON: If turned "ON" then visitor mobile number is required during check-in.
MOBILE_NO_REQUIRED.OFF: If turned "OFF" visitor mobile number will be optional. request.

CONFIRM_MOBILE_NO_REQUIRED.VALUE: Confirm Mobile Number Required ( Mobile app only)
CONFIRM_MOBILE_NO_REQUIRED.ON: If turned "ON" then visitor mobile number to be verified.
CONFIRM_MOBILE_NO_REQUIRED.OFF: If turned "OFF" mobile number field will not be visible to visitor. request.

COMPANY_NAME_REQUIRED.ON: If turned "ON" then company name field is required during check-in.
COMPANY_NAME_REQUIRED.OFF: If turned "OFF" company name field will be optional. request.

CAPTURE_NEW_PHOTO.ON: If turned "ON" then visitor will be asked to take new picture everytime while doing check-in.
CAPTURE_NEW_PHOTO.OFF: If turned "OFF" previously uploaded picture will be used as current picture. request.
